title: LLM Serving
description: Gateway, vLLM engine, KV cache, batching, hardware and logs

panels.title: Model
panels.description: Model the engine serves (API model name).

panels.title: GPU utilisation
panels.description: NVIDIA DCGM exporter. No data on CPU-only, AMD and Apple hosts.

panels.title: TTFT p95
panels.description: Time to first token, engine side, 95th percentile.

panels.title: Output tokens / s
panels.description: Decode throughput of the engine (all requests together).

panels.title: Running (batch)
panels.description: Requests in the current continuous batch.

panels.title: Waiting
panels.description: Requests queued for a batch slot / KV-cache blocks.

panels.title: Prefix cache hits
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from cached KV blocks (automatic prefix caching).

panels.title: End-to-end latency
panels.description: Engine: from arrival to last token. Gateway: as the client sees it (includes the engine).

panels.title: Continuous batch
panels.description: Running = requests batched together this step; waiting = queued.

panels.title: Finished requests / s
panels.description: stop = model finished, length = hit max_tokens, abort = client went away.

panels.title: KV cache usage
panels.description: PagedAttention blocks in use. Near 100% new requests wait and running ones may be preempted.

panels.title: Preemptions / s
panels.description: Requests evicted from the KV cache and recomputed later (memory pressure).

panels.title: GPU memory used
panels.description: vLLM reserves GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION of the GPU up front (weights + KV cache).
